title: DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT
notes: - Audio pulled to the left on a 10-channel interface (Universal Audio Thunderbolt). Launching with a 2-channel output (Mac speakers) and switching back to the interface after the game starts fixes it. - DualSense: keep "Controllers through SDL". Without it the game detects the DualSense natively, but buttons are mismapped and the camera spins. With SDL, set "Change button icons" in Options → Controller to PlayStation for correct prompts. - Tried x64-crossover26.3-r32 (D3DMetal 4.0b3): worse frame rate, went back to x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r30.
issues: Menu screens flicker slightly (in-game is fine); frame pacing uneven even at 60 fps (Composited)
